policy: Every visible operand and calculation is learner-entered. Symbolic frames only; no numeric prefill or main-answer transfer.
sameDenominatorScope: Keep the shared denominator and calculate the numerator. Do not require gcd/reduction content introduced later in the current primary sequence.
otherOperationsScope: Common denominator/scaled numerators for addition/subtraction, reciprocal for division, products for multiplication/division and greatest-common-divisor reduction. Current nonnegative integer numerators and positive denominators. Zero divisor excluded.
checks: Public prompt parsing independent of expression and answer metadata.
Independent exact cross-product equivalence, positive result denominators and coprime results where reduction is taught.
Every frame rejects blank and incorrect input.
Zero numerator, cancellation, invalid division, saved question identity, old draft reset and current draft restore.
KO/EN/PT titles and all instructions and symbolic frames.
testCorrections: Old frame assertions now include learner-entered givens and preserve existing exact result tests.
An updated saved-draft test now uses the returned draft and matching question id, matching the actual application restore call.
limitations: Natural-number fraction operations and other primary fraction concepts remain incomplete.
UI, native evidence, learner inputs and APK artifacts remain private.
Full global app and Play release remain incomplete.
